records.purpose: Provides pharmacies with secure access to prescriptions, medicine verification and dispensing workflows.

records.acceptance: Preserve branch, product/formulation/package, currency, quote time, stock source/time and jurisdiction context. records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.scope: Existing Specialty owns the domain workflow and longitudinal projection only. inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain suspected/confirmed/unknown states, source versions, timestamps and clinician attribution. Test contradictory histories and amended results without silently creating diagnoses. Pediatric guardian access and confidential adolescent segments are separately authorized. Dosing, device commands, surgery, crisis disposition and treatment eligibility require qualified clinical decisions and validated intended-use criteria; source automation claims are not execution authority.

Source-specific disease names, severity scales, treatment pathways, age, phenotype and specialty context remain independent profile variants, not interchangeable clinical protocols. Source-specific scope: Chronic Kidney Disease Module
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded disease-workflows artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain suspected/confirmed/unknown states, source versions, timestamps and clinician attribution. Test contradictory histories and amended results without silently creating diagnoses. Pediatric guardian access and confidential adolescent segments are separately authorized. Dosing, device commands, surgery, crisis disposition and treatment eligibility require qualified clinical decisions and validated intended-use criteria; source automation claims are not execution authority.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded disorder-workflows artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain suspected/confirmed/unknown states, source versions, timestamps and clinician attribution. Test contradictory histories and amended results without silently creating diagnoses. Pediatric guardian access and confidential adolescent segments are separately authorized. Dosing, device commands, surgery, crisis disposition and treatment eligibility require qualified clinical decisions and validated intended-use criteria; source automation claims are not execution authority.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

Source-specific disease names, severity scales, treatment pathways, age, phenotype and specialty context remain independent profile variants, not interchangeable clinical protocols. Transplant eligibility, oncologic staging and precision predictions remain specialist-reviewed. Robotic urology is a clinical workflow profile and cannot issue robot commands; device ownership remains separate. Source-specific scope: Secondary Immunodeficiency Module
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded additional-specialty-pathways artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain suspected/confirmed/unknown states, source versions, timestamps and clinician attribution. Test contradictory histories and amended results without silently creating diagnoses. Pediatric guardian access and confidential adolescent segments are separately authorized. Dosing, device commands, surgery, crisis disposition and treatment eligibility require qualified clinical decisions and validated intended-use criteria; source automation claims are not execution authority. Preserve donor/recipient identity separation, immunosuppression exposure, developmental stage and tumor-specific evidence. No common title establishes an equivalent protocol.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain suspected/confirmed/unknown states, source versions, timestamps and clinician attribution. Test contradictory histories and amended results without silently creating diagnoses. Pediatric guardian access and confidential adolescent segments are separately authorized. records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
